# Knowledge Capture Rule

Capture stable reusable project knowledge discovered while working.

## Store

- architecture facts
- business terminology
- recurring business rules
- integration constraints
- recurring implementation pitfalls
- verified API behavior
- reusable project patterns

## Do Not Store

- temporary reasoning
- irrelevant conversation
- speculative ideas
- secrets
- credentials
- unverified assumptions presented as facts

## Required Metadata

Each knowledge entry should record:

- Source
- Date
- Confidence
- Project Scope
